description: This Java source file defines the CmsEvents class which contains static methods to handle Content Management System (CMS) related HTTP requests within the OFBiz framework. It includes logic for rendering content pages, handling maintenance pages, URL path parsing, content verification, and error handling.

classes.name: CmsEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle CMS page rendering, URL parsing, content verification, and error handling for web requests in OFBiz.

methods.name: cms
methods.description: Handles the CMS request processing: determines requested content, handles maintenance mode, parses URL path info, verifies content access, and renders the appropriate page or error.

methods.name: verifyContentToWebSite
methods.description: Checks if a specific contentId is a publish point for the given webSiteId, including sub-content verification, returning HTTP status codes indicating content availability.

methods.name: verifySubContent
methods.description: Recursively verifies if a contentId is a sub-content of another content by checking ContentAssoc relationships, returning status codes accordingly.
